id: \rI couldn't handle the Battle Tower at first.
en: \rI couldn't handle the Battle Tower at first.
it: \rAll'inizio la Torre Lotta era troppo per me.

id: \rThe Battle Tower is straight forward. Go in and battle your way up.
en: \rThe Battle Tower is straight forward. Go in and battle your way up.

\bLe scuse non faranno abboccare i pesci.

en: \bI don't want to have a rematch. Forget it.

en: \rI should have gotten something out of that. I didn't. I feel empty.
it: \rAvrei dovuto ricavarci qualcosa. E invece niente. Mi sento vuota.

en: \v[1] has changed to have superior stats for attacking!

id: \bI found this in the grass. I was hoping it would help me fish, but it doesn't. You want it?
en: \bI found this in the grass. I was hoping it would help me fish, but it doesn't. You want it?
it: \bL'ho trovato nell'erba. Speravo mi aiutasse a pescare, ma non serve a niente. Lo vuoi?

id: \bI want to get stronger. I'll be a champion one day.
en: \bI want to get stronger. I'll be a champion one day.

en: \bJames: I can't believe our luck. The boss is going to love us for this.

en: \rJessie: We need to capture it first. Hurry, freeze it more so it can't move.

en: \bMeowth: It's the twerp! Hurry and fight them off.

en: \rWhat else can I do for fun?

en: \rI'm ready to go. Are you ready to go?
